Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly introduced Marcus Atius Balbus as a possible spouse of “Julia Caesaris,” conflating Julia, daughter of Julius Caesar and Cornelia (who married Pompey), with Julia Minor, Caesar’s sister (who married Marcus Atius Balbus). This misidentification created an erroneous alternative child-in-law and reflects a failure to verify and synthesize the familial relationships correctly.
